scenario.title: A burst that fills the receive queue ten times over changes nothing that matters
scenario.description: Flood the bus with two hundred copies of the most dominant identifier on it, at one instant, and require that the pack's own telemetry still gets through and that no fault is raised. Then flood it again and inject a genuine over-temperature into the stuffed receive path: the fault frame must still appear inside the same 50 ms budget it would have on an idle bus.

params.label: the pack is publishing telemetry before the flood

steps.params: a second burst, and a real fault injected into the middle of it
